biotools.summary: Meteor is a plateform for quantitative metagenomics profiling of complex ecosystems. Meteor relies on genes catalogue to perform species-level taxonomic profiling (Bacteria, Archaea and Eukaryotes), functional analysis and strain-level population structure inference.
